en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Ibn Sinan, from Ismail Bin Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I said, ‘What is the married man? may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> have Mercy on you<sup>asws</sup>.’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who has a relief (woman) for him he can go to day and night, so he is (classified as) married’.
